name: Digivated Membership
custom_summary: Full UI/UX Prompt Packet, every member-only guide, one reviewed project spotlight, and full News access. $5 once.
description:
One membership. Full access to Digivated.

Digivated Membership is a $5 USD one-time purchase. There are no recurring charges or automatic renewals.

Full News access

Read complete source-checked briefings across AI & Tech, Markets, and Security, including verified company and ticker updates.

Full UI/UX Prompt Packet

Membership includes all 75 prompts, the complete prompt builder, eight workflows, eight checklists, examples, and learning material. You do not need to buy the Prompt Packet separately.

Every member guide

Membership includes the full member-only carousel library and references on Digivated.

One reviewed project spotlight

Your membership includes one project spotlight. Verify your membership at https://digivated.com/membership, then submit a working project for review. We review its image, description, and destination before featuring it. Projects must meet the listing rules; traffic, engagement, and sales are not guaranteed.

How to unlock everything

After checkout, go to https://digivated.com/membership#member-sign-in and verify with your Gumroad receipt email or license key. The same membership unlocks full News briefings, the complete Prompt Packet, and member-only guides. You can also enter your Membership license key at https://digivated.com/access. Keep your receipt and license key private.

Public project discovery, free samples, and standard submissions remain free for everyone. Existing buyers keep their original purchase access and included benefits.

Checkout shows applicable taxes and purchase terms.
